home.intro: Runners try to reach their target, hunters try to catch them. The app is the referee, so everyone can play.
home.codeHint: The code decides your team. Ask the game creator or a teammate for it.
home.createText: Choose a playground on the map and get one join code per team.
home.devHint: Local development only. Location sharing and game rules are not implemented yet.
create.gridSized: 6 × 6 cells · approximately {cell} km × {cell} km each · {total} km × {total} km total
create.cellSizeHint: 0.1–5 km, in steps of 0.1 km. Both comma and dot decimals work.
create.cellSizeInvalid: Enter 0.1–5 km in steps of 0.1 km.
create.sizeFirst: Enter a valid cell size first.
create.pickCenter: Pan the map to move the grid onto your playing area, or tap to place it.
create.checkGrid: Check the entire grid is suitable and permitted for outdoor play, then create the game.
create.center: Center: {latitude}, {longitude} · Columns A–F, rows 1–6 from north to south
create.created: Game created. Share the codes, then join a team yourself.
joinCodes.heading: Join codes
joinCodes.hint: Give each player the code of their team. Players can join until the game starts.
playground.cellSizeInvalid: Cell size must be 0.1–5 km in steps of 0.1 km.
playground.latitudeInvalid: Choose a center between 80° south and 80° north.
playground.dateLine: The playground cannot cross the international date line.
client.unexpectedHealth: Unexpected backend response. Check the API URL.
client.unexpectedGame: Unexpected game response. Check the API URL.
client.unexpectedJoin: Unexpected join response. Check the API URL.
client.unexpectedState: Unexpected game state. Check the API URL.
client.name: Enter a name with 1–{max} characters.
client.teamName: Enter a team name with 1–{max} characters.
client.timeout: Connection timed out. Check the API URL and your network.
client.unreachable: Could not reach the backend. Check the API URL and your network.
location.notificationTitle: Catch me! is sharing your location
location.notificationBody: Your team sees your position while the game runs.
lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.testMode: TEST MODE — start position check disabled
lobby.testModeText: Ready and the countdown do not depend on your position. Your real GPS location is still shared normally.
lobby.runningInfo: Catching and reaching the target arrive in the next milestone.
lobby.countdownInfo: Everyone is ready. Joining, leaving, un-readying, or a runner moving away from the start cancels the countdown.
lobby.countdownInfoTest: Everyone is ready. Joining, leaving, or un-readying cancels the countdown.
lobby.startInfo: The game starts 10 seconds after all players are ready and both teams have at least one player. Runners must be at the start of the route; hunters need a hunter team.
lobby.startInfoTest: The game starts 10 seconds after all players are ready and both teams have at least one player. Hunters need a hunter team.
lobby.revealHunter: Every 5 minutes you see where each runner was at that moment.
lobby.revealRunner: Every 5 minutes the hunters see where you are at that moment.
lobby.legendRunner: ● You (green) · teammates (blue). Runners never see hunters.
lobby.legendHunter: ● You (green) · your hunter team (blue) · revealed runners (red). Runners never see hunters.
lobby.shareRunnerStart: Runners must prove they are at the start of the route before getting ready.
lobby.shareHunterLobby: Your hunter team sees your position, already in the lobby.
lobby.shareRunning: Your teammates see your position while the game runs.
lobby.shareRunningForeground: Your teammates see your position while the game runs. It is only shared while this screen is open.
lobby.locationBlocked: Location access is blocked. Allow it in the system settings.
lobby.sharingForeground: Sharing while the screen is on
lobby.sharingBackgroundText: Your position keeps being shared when the screen is off or you switch apps, until you leave the game screen or close the app.
lobby.backgroundUnavailable: Keep this screen open. Background sharing needs an installed app build; Expo Go and browsers cannot share in the background.
lobby.allowAlways: Allow "Always" location access to keep sharing when the screen is off.
lobby.backgroundBlocked: Background location is blocked. Allow "Always" in the system settings, or keep this screen open.
lobby.route: Get from {start} to {stop} without being caught. Straight-line distance: {distance} km.
lobby.goToStart: You are {meters} m from the start. Get within {radius} m to get ready.
lobby.checkDisabled: The start-position check is disabled for testing.
lobby.needHunterTeam: Join or create a hunter team to get ready.
lobby.hunterTeamHint: Hunters of the same team see each other's positions. Other hunter teams never see yours.
lobby.unreadyForTeam: Set yourself not ready to change your team.
